The '''Botor Enclave''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] territory that included around two dozen [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], including the [[Botor system/Legends|Botor system]] and the [[Kerensik system/Legends|Kerensik system]]. It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Botori]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which had a [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long history of warfare against the [[Dawferim]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of the neighboring [[Daupherm Planet States]]. Holding the status of an [[Allied Region]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Botor Enclave declared its independence from both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] following the former's fragmentation at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Description==
The Botor Enclave was a territory situated in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It adjoined the area known as the [[Daupherm Planet States]] as well as the southern edge of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:EvramDarkmere.png|thumb|left|200px|One of the wars involving the Botor Enclave cost the life of the mother of Evram Darkmere (pictured).]]
Since accepting the status of an [[Allied Region]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the early period of that government, the [[Botori]] inhabitants of the Botor Enclave and their ancient rival,<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Dawferim]]<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of the nearby Daupherm Planet States, engaged in at least forty wars, with some of them lasting for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. A large number of laws and traditions regulating nearly every aspect of the conflicts, including vendettas, [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]], and all-out war, emerged over the subsequent [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]. Both the Republic and its successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], only intervened in the Botor-Daupherm conflicts when they began to spill over into the larger [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Evram Darkmere's mother|pirate]] who was the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of the Dawferim [[Evram Darkmere]] [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> around [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]],<ref name="CROdate">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', which is set shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], establishes that [[Evram Darkmere's mother]] [[Death/Legends|died]] thirty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, which corresponds to around [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> during one of<ref name="CRO" /> the long wars between the Botor Enclave and the Daupherm Planet States.<ref name="TEA" /> By [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="10 ABY">The ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'' is set six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which corresponds to [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Botor Enclave and the Dawferim had engaged in a five-hundred-[[Standard year/Legends|years]]-long small-scale [[Daupherm-Boton Conflict|feud]] that attracted renegades and [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] from nearby [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. Also by that [[Time/Legends|time]], the systems of the Botor Enclave grouped together and formed a protective federation due to the lack of a centralized [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government and the continuing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|conflict]] between the Empire and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] following the former's fragmentation at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="DES" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> In the process, the Botor Enclave also declared its independence from both the Empire and the New Republic.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
The Botor Enclave was inhabited by an [[Bear/Legends|ursine]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the Botori. The population of the Botor system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between 100 million to 500 million.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Botor Income Ministry]] was an institution that operated in the Botor Enclave by the time the Battle of Endor was fought.<ref name="DES" />

==Locations==
[[File:KaneGriggs-DE3.png|thumb|right|200px|Kane Griggs was a native of the Botor Enclave.]]
The Botor Enclave consisted of approximately two dozen [[Star/Legends|star]] systems,<ref name="TEA" /> including the [[Botor system/Legends|Botor]] and [[Kerensik system/Legends|Kerensik systems]],<ref name="EAOC" /> that were located within the fringes of a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Kerensik system contained the [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kerensik]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of<ref name="DES" /> the Human<ref name="DE3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref> [[Kane Griggs]], who enrolled in an off-world [[University/Legends|university]] of the Galactic Empire years prior to<ref name="DES" /> [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="GriggsDate">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'' establishes that [[Kane Griggs]] left [[Kerensik]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]], which occurred in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

The territory surrounding the Botor system was widely [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] and [[8000 BBY]]<ref name="TEA" /> and it had become a part of the Galactic Republic by approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]. From approximately [[17,000 BBY]]<ref name="EGTW" /> to [[3956 BBY]], the Botor system lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="TEA" /> known as the [[Hidakai Pool]], which connected it to the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado]] and [[Daupherm system/Legends|Daupherm systems]].<ref name="EGTW" /> That [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route, however, had ceased to exist by [[1004 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Botor system remained within the boundaries of the Republic during the final phase of the [[New Sith Wars]] from 1004 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], and later during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the first campaigns of the latter conflict, the [[Twentieth Army]] of the Republic was tasked with protecting the vicinity of the system against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the Botor system had been incorporated into the territory of the Empire.<ref name="EGTW" /> [[29 ABY/Legends|Forty-six years]] later, [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic military forces]] passed through the system as part of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war effort]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Botor Enclave was first mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'', which was authored by [[Michael Allen Horne]] and published for use with the [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="DES" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the region in grid square K-12.<ref name="TEA" />
